title: 10 Things I Regret About Node.js - Ryan Dahl - JSConf EU
summary: Node.js creator Ryan Dahl discusses ten design mistakes he made in Node, including package.json, npm, and module resolution. The talk sets out the motivations behind his later project, Deno.
why: HN treats it as the classic talk on why Deno exists and on lessons from design mistakes in a widely used platform.

quote.text: Ryan Dahl's great talk on design mistakes he made with node.js is something I think about all the time
